title: Triple win for CNH brands at the 2026 Red Dot Design Awards
summary: Triple win for CNH brands at the 2026 Red Dot Design Awards The winning tractor designs are: Case IH Puma New Holland T7 Standard Wheelbase STEYR Cervus CVT Basildon, May 5, 2026 CNH (NYSE: CNH) is proud to announce that three models from its Case IH, New Holland, and STEYR ® brands, have won 2026 Red Dot Design Awards. Red Dot is one of the world’s most prestigious design competitions, honoring products that stand out for design quality, innovation and usability. “When design works seamlessly for our customers, it elevates both performance and pride of ownership,” said Lisa Jackson, Head of Design and UX at CNH. "This recognition across multiple designs reflects our commitment to creating machines where distinctive, thoughtful design goes hand-in-hand with real-world value for farmers.” THE WINNERS The Case IH Puma ® series combines bold Case IH family styling with a significantly enhanced cab environment designed to support long working days.
